newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - HNC Software started. [CORRECTED 22:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - HNC Software started. [CORRECTED 22:15 GMT]

text.p: EVEREN Securities said it initiated coverage of HNC Software Inc with a buy rating and a six-month price target of $40 per share, because the company was building a strong position in neural networks.
-- Analyst Rob Helf said his 1997 earnings estimate was $0.52 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate was $0.77 per share. His 18-month price target was $56 per share.

-- "The company is building a leadership position in neural networks and its products (corrects from shares) have shown evidence of fast payback for customers," Helf said. He said business was good for HNC at the moment.
